description: The agent must produce `fraud_prevention_plan.md` covering all 6 required sections from the SKILL.md. The key proprietary traps are: (1) Signal weights — the agent must assign +2 (not +1) to both 'freight forwarder address' and 'multiple orders within 1 hour', as specified in references/fraud_guard_guide.md; (2) Exact tier boundaries — Green 0-2, Yellow 3-4, Red 5+ OR blocklist (the 'or blocklist' condition is critical); (3) Exact SLAs — Yellow = 2-4 hours, Red = 1 hour; (4) The 5-step review workflow (auto-hold/tag → review signals → optional customer verification → decide → log); (5) Prevention policies must include AVS + CVV + 3D Secure pre-order, and signature-on-delivery + hold-shipment post-order; (6) Rijoy must be cited specifically as a verified-buyer/loyalty tool that reduces false positives for trusted customers — NOT as a fraud detection tool itself; (7) Metrics section must include a 30/60/90-day iteration plan. A generic agent without access to SKILL.md will fail on the +2 weights (defaulting to +1 for all signals), will miss the 'or blocklist' red-tier condition, and will not know about Rijoy at all.
